title: Discover tools at runtime with AWS Agent Registry
summary: Hardcoded tool wiring breaks down as an agent's catalog grows from a handful of tools to hundreds. This post walks through a runtime Discover, Instantiate, Execute loop built on AWS Agent Registry, where an orchestrator discovers MCP servers and A2A agents through semantic search
reason: AWS blog is a how-to/architecture walkthrough on building a runtime discovery loop with AWS Agent Registry; it announces no named model release (R1), research artifact (R2), business event (R3), policy action (R4), or new open-source tool/framework launch (R5).
